title: Annual meeting.
bodyText: The council shall schedule and conduct a meeting in accordance with chapter 92 in each year of its operation.
bodyHtml: §200D-4  Annual meeting.  The council shall schedule and conduct a meeting in accordance with chapter 92 in each year of its operation. [L 1993, c 317, pt of §2, §7; am L 1998, c 4, §3; am L 2009, c 68, §1; am L 2010, c 19, §§2, 4]
